T: Choose your character. Choose your snack.
D: Four teens in detention get sucked into a video game and become its avatars.
P: Serve dessert, carefully, when Mouse Finch learns his weakness is cake.
S: Detention sweet and salty snack mix
Honey popcorn baked crisp and tossed with a bag of salty snacks

Ridged chips, pretzels and chocolate-coated peanuts tossed with honey-roasted popcorn, with a bowl of sour lollies like a stash smuggled into detention. Pop 80g popping corn in 1 tbsp oil in a covered pot. Warm 2 tbsp honey with 20g butter and a pinch of salt, toss through the popcorn and bake at 160C for 8 minutes, then cool. Toss with a 170g bag of ridged potato chips, 150g pretzels and 150g chocolate-coated peanuts in a big bowl. Put 200g sour lollies in a small bowl alongside.

Chicken thigh marinated in yoghurt, garlic, paprika and lemon, grilled on skewers until charred, with garlic yoghurt dip and warm flatbread. Cut 800g chicken thighs into chunks and marinate for 2 hours in 150g Greek yoghurt, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cumin, lemon juice and salt. Thread onto 8 skewers and grill on high for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with a grated garlic clove, lemon and mint. Warm 4 flatbreads on the grill.
Mango, red onion, chilli, coriander and lime salsa with corn chips

Sweet ripe mango, red onion, chilli and coriander sharpened with lime, scooped up with salted corn chips. Dice 2 mangoes and mix with half a diced red onion, 1 chopped chilli, a handful of coriander and the juice of 2 limes. Season with salt and rest 10 minutes so the juices come out. Serve with 230g corn chips.
M: Rump marinated in garlic, chilli and lime, grilled over high heat and sliced, with a sharp parsley chimichurri and buttered charred corn. Marinate 1kg rump steak in 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, the juice of a lime and 2 tbsp oil for 1 hour. Chop a bunch of parsley with 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, chilli flakes, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil. Grill the steak 4 minutes a side and rest 8 minutes. Grill 4 corn cobs until charred and roll in butter. Slice the steak and spoon over chimichurri.
Chicken thighs in red curry coconut sauce with lemongrass and lime leaves
Red curry paste fried in thick coconut cream until fragrant, chicken thighs, coconut milk, bruised lemongrass, torn lime leaves, fish sauce and palm sugar, simmered 20 minutes. Jasmine rice.
W: Dense chocolate layer cake covered in chocolate ganache
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour folded in, baked in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes, layered and covered in glossy ganache. Eat with care.
K: Pineapple, mango and passionfruit juice with lime and soda over crushed ice
Pineapple juice, mango nectar and fresh passionfruit pulp with a squeeze of lime, topped with soda water over crushed ice.

steps.text: Pop the corn in the oil in a covered pot.
Warm the honey with the butter and a pinch of salt and toss through the popcorn.
Bake at 160C, then cool.
Toss with the chips, pretzels and chocolate peanuts in a big bowl and put the lollies in a small bowl alongside.
Dice the mangoes and the onion and chop the chilli and coriander.
Mix with lime juice and salt.
Rest so the juices come out, then serve with corn chips.
Fry the curry paste in the thick top of the coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the chicken, the remaining coconut milk, bruised lemongrass, torn lime leaves, fish sauce and palm sugar.
Simmer gently until the chicken is cooked through.
Cook the rice and serve alongside.
Fry the curry paste in the thick top of the coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the pumpkin, the remaining coconut milk, bruised lemongrass, torn lime leaves, soy sauce and palm sugar.
Simmer gently until the pumpkin is tender, adding the tofu for the last 5 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve alongside.
Melt part of the chocolate with the butter, whisk in the eggs and sugar and fold in the flour.
Bake in two tins at 170C.
Cool completely.
Melt the remaining chocolate with the cream into a ganache.
Layer the cakes and cover with the ganache.

s.note: Honey popcorn baked crisp and tossed with a bag of salty snacks
s.how: Pop 80g popping corn in 1 tbsp oil in a covered pot. Warm 2 tbsp honey with 20g butter and a pinch of salt, toss through the popcorn and bake at 160C for 8 minutes, then cool. Toss with a 170g bag of ridged potato chips, 150g pretzels and 150g chocolate-coated peanuts in a big bowl. Put 200g sour lollies in a small bowl alongside.

m.note: Chicken thighs in red curry coconut sauce with lemongrass and lime leaves
m.how: Fry 3 tbsp red curry paste in the thick top of 400ml coconut milk until fragrant. Add 800g sliced chicken thighs, the rest of the coconut milk, a bruised lemongrass stalk, torn lime leaves, fish sauce and palm sugar. Simmer 20 minutes. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.note: Dense chocolate layer cake covered in chocolate ganache
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 170C for 30 minutes. Layer and cover with 150g chocolate melted with 150ml cream.

d.note: Pineapple, mango and passionfruit juice with lime and soda over crushed ice
d.how: Mix 400ml pineapple juice, 400ml mango nectar, the pulp of 3 passionfruit and the juice of a lime. Pour over crushed ice in four glasses and top with soda water.
